questions.question: Which of the following genres describes an image that portrays a single person in their characteristics?
questions.explanation: Portrait is a classic art genre that aims to depict the essence, personality, and appearance of a person. This genre has a long tradition in art history and includes many well-known works by various artists.

questions.question: Which of these animals plays a crucial role in the ecosystem by pollinating plants and thus contributing to reproduction?
questions.explanation: Bees are crucial for pollinating many plants, thus contributing to biodiversity and food production. Their role in the ecosystem is indispensable as they support the reproduction of many plant species.

questions.question: What is one of the main functions of content moderation in social media?
choices: A: Reviewing and filtering posts to remove harmful content.
B: Developing new features within the platform.
C: Enhancing the user interface for a better user experience.
D: Promoting advertisements and sponsored content.
questions.explanation: Content moderation is crucial for social media to ensure that platforms remain free of harmful content such as hate speech or spam. This creates a safer space for users and improves the quality of interactions.
